title: Roles & Permissions wording renamed from Catalog to Part Library
custom_preconds: 1. You are on Administration -> Roles & Permissions -> Edit Role, on the build under test.
custom_steps:
1. Read the permission group title and its description.
  2. Read the Parts Department card description above that group.
  3. Read the three permission labels in that group.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The permission group is titled "Part Library and Inventory" (was "Catalog and Inventory") with description "Manage the parts library and inventory levels." (was "...catalog..."); the Parts Department card reads "Manage parts inventory, part library, sales, and vendor operations." (was "...catalog...").
  • The three labels read "Part Library & Inventory - View / Create & Edit / Delete" (were "Catalog & Inventory - ...").

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 12 (Rename Catalog to Part Library); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R6: “On Administration -> Roles & Permissions -> Edit Role, the permission group is titled Part Library and Inventory. It was titled Catalog and Inventory.”
  • S12-R7: “That group's description reads Manage the parts library and inventory levels. It read Manage the parts catalog and inventory levels.”
  • S12-R8: “The Parts Department card description above that group reads Manage parts inventory, part library, sales, and vendor operations. It read Manage parts inventory, catalog, sales, and vendor operations.”
  • S12-R9: “The three permission labels read Part Library & Inventory - View, Part Library & Inventory - Create & Edit and Part Library & Inventory - Delete. They read Catalog & Inventory - View, Catalog & Inventory - Create & Edit and Catalog & Inventory - Delete.”
